verdict.rationale: smolagents documents an in-run agent memory that developers can access directly, replay, and modify through step callbacks. It also supports step-by-step execution for long-running tool calls, which gives a developer hooks to build persistence on their own. Nothing in the evidence shows a built-in long-term memory store, or memory that persists across separate sessions or threads. missing for 10: built-in persistent or long-term memory storage, cross-session/thread memory restore, documented save/load of memory, independent corroboration.
